paper.title: Live-Evo: Online Evolution of Agentic Memory from Continuous Feedback
paper.central_claim: 通过经验/元指导双库、任务化编译与对比反馈在线进化记忆，持续提升真实预测及深度研究。

provenance.notes: 派发sonnet→gpt-6.1-sol；无独立可核验收据，实际模型及会话字段保留null，不探测。

materials.notes: 全文已读；无manifest页图，图曲线不估值。

evidence.quote: by producing and comparing two independent predictions, one guided by the compiled guideline and one as a memory-free baseline, to quantify the contribution of the guideline.
evidence.support_explanation: 每任务独立memory-on/off对照；是整组记忆的反事实而非逐条剔除。

evidence.quote: it updates experience weights based on the observed performance gap; if the guideline underperforms, the agent generates a new entry for the Meta-Guideline Bank.
evidence.support_explanation: 留存效用权重和编译元指导；不等于验证了improver后代能力。

evidence.quote: We then re-evaluate the task with this candidate experience, and commit it to the experience bank only if it yields a statistically significant improvement over the original memory-on score.
evidence.support_explanation: 同一失败题提议与再测准入；显著性主张无检验定义。

evidence.quote: a future-prediction benchmark spanning the latest 10 weeks with 500 tasks in total.
We enforce strict time-based retrieval on google-search tool to prevent information leakage past the close time.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者宣称严格时间过滤，附录示例构成反向信号。

evidence.quote: We split the benchmark into 10 folds, learn experience sequentially across folds, and report the overall average accuracy.
evidence.support_explanation: XBench为顺序适应不是冻结单次跨域留出。

evidence.quote: We use serper api as the google-search api and apply the time filter by editing the queries.
evidence.support_explanation: 查询编辑不能独自担保抓取内容无赛后信息；无抓取快照审计。
预测任务轨迹已读到比赛结论，直接挑战无赛后信息声明；不推广为所有题均泄漏。

evidence.quote: Identified close 33-31 victory conditions. Weighed resilience despite injuries and home advantage more heavily than static odds.
evidence.support_explanation: 示例推理提及精确完赛比分，需独立时间证据解释。

evidence.quote: w/o weight-update fixes all experience weights, w/o meta-guideline removes meta-guidance bank for guideline generation, w/o guideline-synthesis directly uses retrieved experiences, and w/o active-retrieve queries memory using only the question.
evidence.support_explanation: 四个可分离模块消融，但无等预算多执行对照。

evidence.quote: The max turns of one task is set to 20.
evidence.support_explanation: 单任务轮数上限，不是整轮优化成本。
